verdict.rationale: Factory documents a Sessions API for creating and driving Droid sessions, publishes an OpenAPI spec, and offers an SDK and CLI that run the same agent harness and runtime as the web and desktop app. That gives programmatic access to the core agent workflow, but nothing shows full parity with UI features. Missing for 10: documented API parity for UI surfaces such as Software Factory metrics and automations, usage reporting, settings and design mode, an explicit API-parity statement, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create and drive Droid sessions: manage their lifecycle, settings, and messages.
The Droid SDK lets you run the same agent harness that powers Factory's CLI, desktop application, and web platform from your own code.
It gives the same Factory runtime through an interactive terminal UI with project context, approvals, MCP tools, Missions, and headless execution.
